In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the neutrino mass and mixing matrix is not unitary.
the unitarity of the mixing matrix is violated in a model of neutrino mass generation with extra spacelike dimensions at the level of O ( 1 % ).
the unitary violation is a result of the non-Abelian nature of the gauge group, the non-Abelion nature of the gauge coupling, and the non-Abellian nature of the gauge field strength tensor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the unitarity violation in neutrino mixing is a generic feature of the models with extra spacelike dimensions.
the unitary condition for the neutrino mass mixing matrix can be violated in a model of sequential neutrino mixing.
the neutrino oscillation data can be explained by a model with a single extra dimension, and that the model can explain the small lepton number violation observed in neutrino oscillation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
unitarity violation in neutrino mixing is not necessarily a signal of new physics at the TeV scale, but can be a consequence of new physics at much higher scales.

the unitarity violation is not a generic feature of models with large extra dimensions, and can be avoided in the case of a compactification scale of the order of 10^10 GeV, which is consistent with current constraints.
